name: Hugging Face antirez/deepseek-v4.1-flash-gguf model card
notes: GGUF card for DwarfStar (github.com/antirez/ds4). Page reports model size 755B params, architecture deepseek41. Q2 file is 340.60 GiB of which 151.77 GiB are main weights; each language GGUF also carries 188.83 GiB of native FP8 Engram tables that DwarfStar streams from disk rather than loading resident. Source checkpoint deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at df42c109. Accessed 2026-10-17.
